name: soundcheck-live
description: Soundcheck member MCP (OAuth sign-in, no API keys, 249 tools) for running live events: gigs, crew shifts and offers, call lists, run of show and setlists, venues, gig-file import and settlement. Anything that messages crew asks you first and names who will be told. A no-login public MCP (18 tools) is included as a fallback for reviewers and discovery.
